sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is a 1.5-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team. It is designed for efficient on-device or self-hosted deployment, supporting chat/conversational tasks with improvements in coding, math, instruction following, and structured output (JSON). sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct install, users can directly use Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
